keyFindings: Site launched ~Feb 3 — only 3 days of GA data with 32 users (100% Direct), zero organic search sessions
Google has indexed 49 location pages and 1 service page, generating ~398 impressions but 0 clicks (0% CTR) — all pages rank position 20-100+
Plumbing queries dominate (~90% of impressions) with HVAC queries at ~7% — electrical queries are absent entirely
Top 5 location pages by impressions: McKinney (45), Frisco (33), Rowlett (30), Denton (28), Kennedale (27) — these are the cities Google sees the site as most relevant for
Homepage and service pages are nearly invisible in search — only /services/cooling has 1 impression at position 91
biggestOpportunities: Location pages are already indexed and getting impressions — optimize the top 10 location pages to move from position 50-80 toward page 1-2
Generic high-intent queries like 'emergency plumber' (position 16.5) and 'plumber service' (position 14.5) show the site CAN rank on page 2 for competitive terms
Zero service page visibility — getting /services/plumbing and sub-pages indexed and optimized would capture the service-intent queries driving location page impressions
HVAC queries cluster around Farmers Branch — optimize that location page with HVAC-specific content
topRisks: Brand new domain with zero backlink authority — positions 50-90 are typical but won't generate clicks without authority building
Homepage not appearing in Search Console at all — may not be indexed or not matching any search queries
Zero conversion tracking in GA — when traffic arrives, there's no way to measure leads
Data is extremely thin (3 days of GA, 28 days of GSC) — conclusions are directional, not definitive
